name: Crocalor
description: Crocalor, the Fire Croc Pokémon, and the evolved form of Fuecoco. Able to evolve into Skeledirge. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.
The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
